org.name: Northwind Coffee
org.description: An independent coffee roaster selling beans and subscriptions online and to local cafés.

voice.summary: Warm, knowledgeable and unpretentious, like a barista who really knows their stuff.
rules: Specifics over adjectives: "roasted 48 hours ago" beats "incredibly fresh"
Teach something in every post, sell second

content_insights.description: Weekly social performance analysis: top/bottom posts, what worked, recommendations

weekly_updates.description: What shipped or changed this week, written up for customers

content_briefs.description: Long-form article briefs. Status: Brief Ready → In Progress → Ready to Publish → Published

social_drafts.description: One entry per week with a draft per platform. Status: Draft Ready → Posted

pipeline.description: Sales / partnership pipeline. Status: New → Contacted → Follow Up → Replied → Won / Lost. Has a 'Last Contact' date.

channel_memory.description: Daily per-channel chat summaries (Channel, Date, Day, Summary)

platforms.Instagram: Caption of 80–150 words. Hook in the first line, 3–5 relevant hashtags at the end.
platforms.LinkedIn: 150–300 words. One-line hook, 3–5 short paragraphs, end with a question.
platforms.Facebook: 100–200 words. Warm, conversational, end with a question or CTA.

schedule.description: Summarise every channel into long-term memory
Monday morning digest in the content channel
Friday brief proposal, posted for approval
